dataset.name: Candidate master file
dataset.description: Basic candidate registration attributes published as one pipe-delimited record per included candidate in a two-year bulk snapshot.

acquisition.pagination: None. Each requested two-year period is one complete ZIP snapshot.

partitions.name: two_year_period
partitions.source: Requested bulk URL path; cycle_suffix is the period's final two digits.
partitions.purpose: Snapshot acquisition, replay, and downstream assertion scope. It is not taken from CAND_ELECTION_YR.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries for transport failures; follow redirects; publish only after validating the HTTP result, ZIP integrity, exact member name, archive digest, row width, and record count.

physical_schema.line_ending: LF with a required final LF in the verified 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2026 artifacts
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: An empty physical line becomes an explicit record-boundary issue; it is never silently skipped.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve every empty source field as the empty string. Do not convert it to null, zero, an inferred code, or an inherited value at the source boundary.

identity.occurrence_locator: archive SHA-256 + exact member name + one-based physical line number
identity.record_version: occurrence locator + SHA-256 of the exact source line
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every physical occurrence. Repeated CAND_ID values are evidence; conflicting values block any single-record projection for that candidate and partition.

time_fields.meaning: The requested FEC bulk snapshot period. This is acquisition scope, not a fact date.
The candidate's election year reported in this source record; it can differ from the snapshot period.

rules: Keep the source snapshot period and CAND_ELECTION_YR as separate dimensions.
Do not use names, addresses, party, or principal committee IDs as entity identity.
Preserve the source spelling and punctuation before any search normalization.
A candidate record is an assertion from one accepted snapshot, not a timeless candidate profile.
Do not discard a record because its CAND_ELECTION_YR differs from the requested snapshot period.

revisions.publisher_model: The FEC replaces each two-year bulk archive with a current snapshot and does not expose row-level revision identifiers in this file.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. Retain every acquired archive as an immutable snapshot; any current-view selection must name its snapshot and resolve duplicate-key conflicts explicitly.

checks.rule: The archive digest, requested period, exact cn.txt member, retrieval time, and response metadata are present.
Every physical line has exactly 15 fields; short rows are not padded and extra fields are not truncated.
Every source byte decodes under the accepted encoding; invalid bytes are retained as failed raw evidence, never silently dropped.
Every non-empty physical line becomes one record occurrence or one explicit issue.
Conflicting records for one CAND_ID and source period remain separate and block a singleton projection.
Member name, field order, or field count changes require contract review.

scenarios: candidate election year equals snapshot period
candidate election year differs from snapshot period

use.retention: Retain the exact archive, HTTP metadata, archive digest, member inventory, record occurrences, and issues indefinitely; derived projections are rebuildable.
use.disclaimer: Candidate master data reports FEC registration attributes for a captured source snapshot. It does not by itself establish candidacy status, financial activity, or election outcome outside that scope.
